howto.name: Upload PNG images
howto.text: Drop one or many .png files up to 500 MB total.

howto.name: Choose page size
howto.text: Letter or A4. Transparency in PNGs renders against a white page background.

howto.name: Download the PDF
howto.text: All images become a single PDF, one per page. Lossless — PNG pixels map directly to PDF image objects.

faq.q: Will the PDF be larger than the PNGs?
faq.a: Roughly the same — PNGs are already losslessly compressed, and PDF embeds them with minimal overhead.
Transparent PNGs render over a white background. If you need true alpha through, use the Image to PDF generic tool with the keep-alpha option.

faq.q: Is there a max number of images?
faq.a: Practical limit is around 100 images per conversion before browser upload time becomes inconvenient. Backend limit is 500 MB total.
